message.content:
**Battle of Stalingrad (1942‑1943)** | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Main participants** | • **Soviet Union** – Red Army (commanded by General Georgy Zhukov, later by General Vasily Trofimov).
• **Nazi Germany** – Wehrmacht’s 6th Army (initially under General Friedrich Kaiser, later General Fedor von Bock).
Other Axis allies (Italy, Hungary, Romania) contributed support units, but the core combatants were the Soviet and German forces. | | **Location** | The city of **Stalingrad** (now **Volgograd**) in southern Russia, on the eastern bank of the **Volga River**. The battle encompassed the urban center, surrounding suburbs, and the Volga’s strategic crossing points. | The confrontation became one of the war’s most brutal and decisive engagements, ultimately turning the tide in favor of the Allies on the Eastern Front.
